  • Interface with business analysts and technical staff and be responsible for delivering complete work products
  • Implement App Exchange platforms
  • Research integration issues and work closely with team members on operations and development staff
  • Research and development of new Salesforce.com prototypes and applications
  • Research and keep current on force.com technologies and communicate trends and future needs to leadership
  • Perform maintenance and troubleshooting of applications
  • Build client trust and respect, establish client relationships, and develop rapport with client
  • Participate and engage in all team meetings
  • Document best practices and operational procedures
  • Facilitate continuous improvement within the environment

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree and 7 years of work experience
  • 5+ years of experience with Salesforce development
  • Functional knowledge of Salesforce.com data structure and understanding of how to leverage the tool to meet complex process and reporting requirements
  • Must have proven knowledge and practical application of Visualforce, APEX programming, Force.com APIs, and Web Services
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain and government security clearance 
  • Salesforce Developer certification(s)

  • Unique combination of being business-minded and highly analytical while also having a strong and deep technical background in Salesforce.com
  • Ability to work on multiple tasks and deliver results with aggressive timelines
  • Able and willing to work independently and in a fast-paced environment with tight deadlines, with minimal supervision

As part of the application process, you are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

raw.description:
Building a business from their passion for energy markets. That’s what our founders did in 2005 and that’s still what they do today, supported by an international team of energy experts who help spread this passion all over the world. What does our team bring to the table? A set of highly specialized consultancy services: quality energy risk management, procurement, financial controlling, sustainability, and data management solutions based on the most in-depth knowledge of energy procurement that you can find. At E&C Consultants, energy buying isn’t just a branch of our business – it’s in our DNA.

We are looking for a student who speaks Polish & English to support our Energy procurement & Sustainability consultants working in the Central-European energy markets . We guarantee flexibility so you can combine your studies with work.

What will you do?

As a student, you will be working closely with energy consultants, external energy suppliers and other third parties in the Central European markets.

Your key responsibilities will be:

  • collecting, processing and maintaining client’s contract data

  • gathering and confirming quotations

  • Preparing RFP's

  • helping consultants promptly respond to queries

  • updating templates and reports

  • managing follow up emails and sometimes calls

What do we offer you?

  • You will be at the forefront of changes in the energy industry at a time when the biggest energy transition since the industrial revolution is taking place.

  • Training by a consultant expert

  • Unique atmosphere within young, ambitious and international team.

  • Remote work possible

Requirements

Who are we looking for?

  • A student willing to work & grow, available at least 20 hours/week

  • Working schedule is flexible and can be discussed

  • You are pursuing a Energy/Environmental degree or you pursue a math, physics, engineering, business administration or finance degree.

  • Proficient in English & Polish, both written and oral

  • Knowledge of Hungarian or Romanian is a nice to have

  • Quick learner who can work in a fast-paced environment

  • Persistent person who knows how to reach goals

  • Accurate and precise with a good eye for details

  • Well organized with a proactive approach

  • Experienced user of Microsoft office package especially Excel and Outlook

  • Interest in energy sector is a plus although extensive training will be provided

Send your application by clicking on the application button.

Please send us your CV in English only and include the following statement in your application: "I hereby give consent for my personal data included in my application to be processed for the purposes of the recruitment process under the Personal Data Protection Act as of 29 August 1997, consolidated text: Journal of Laws 2015, item 2135 as amended".
